read.thesis: Emerson's underlying orders grew 5% and backlog rose 9% to $8.2B with book-to-bill 1.07, but the Middle East cut FY26 underlying growth to 3% and China is now down mid-single digits, with no capacity or capex signal.

triggers.label: Backlog up 9% to $8.2B
triggers.quote: Backlog ended the quarter at $8.2 billion, up 9% year over year, and our book-to-bill was 1.07.

triggers.label: FY26 underlying growth cut to 3%
triggers.quote: we are adjusting our full-year guidance for sales to reflect the Middle East conflict and now expect full-year underlying sales growth of approximately 3%.

triggers.label: China now down mid-single digits
triggers.quote: which we now expect to be down mid-single digits for the year.

triggers.label: Price contributed 3.5 points
triggers.quote: Price contributed 3.5 points to growth, as expected, and MRO was 65% of sales.

guidance.quote: now expect full-year underlying sales growth of approximately 3%.
We are raising the bottom and midpoint of our 2026 adjusted EPS guide and now expect $6.45 to $6.55.
We still expect adjusted segment EBITDA margin of approximately 28%
We still expect adjusted segment EBITDA margin of approximately 28% and free cash flow of $3.5 billion to $3.6 billion.
We continue to see robust adoption of our software and still expect ACV growth of 10% plus in 2026.
We expect adjusted segment EBITDA margin of approximately 28% and adjusted EPS of $1.65 to $1.70.
We still expect to return approximately $2.2 billion to shareholders
